finalText:
Build's clean now. Two real bugs, both from the same option-shape change in the bump.

`src/core/options.js` still read `options.retries`, but the new bundler passes `retryCount` instead. `src/net/retryPolicy.js` treated a missing flag as an error, but the new config loader leaves unset flags as `undefined` instead of `false`. Fixed both, and the rest was just deprecation noise.

Build now exits 0 with 8 warnings, all harmless deprecation notices, 0 errors.
